t: This is the Victoria and Albert Museum, a Grade I listed building. Three men are credited with its design. Francis Fowke was an engineer and architect, and a captain in the Royal Engineers, who made use of iron-framed construction with large open galleries. Henry Young Darracott Scott was also a Royal Engineers officer, best known as joint designer and builder of the Royal Albert Hall. Sir Aston Webb designed the main building, and also the principal façade of Buckingham Palace. He was president of the Royal Academy from 1919 to 1924.
